        x1=df_sorted["lat"].max(),
        y1=df_sorted["Population"].max(),
        line=dict(color="red")
    )
])

import plotly.express as px
import pandas as pd

# Filter data for California and Texas
df_california = df[df["Provider State"] == "CA"]
df_texas = df[df["Provider State"] == "TX"]

# Calculate total number of records for each state
df_california_records = df_california.groupby("Classification")["Number of Records"].sum().reset_index()
df_texas_records = df_texas.groupby("Classification")["Number of Records"].sum().reset_index()

# Create bar chart with Plotly
fig = px.bar(
    x="Classification",
    y="Number of Records",
    color_discrete_sequence=["blue", "red"],
    title="Number of Alcohol and Drug Use Records in California vs. Texas"
)

# Update data for each state
fig.add_trace(
    go.Bar(
        x=df_california_records["Classification"],
        y=df_california_records["Number of Records"],
        name="California",
        marker_color="blue",
        opacity=0.8,
    )
)
fig.add_trace(
    go.Bar(
        x=df_texas_records["Classification"],
        y=df_texas_records["Number of Records"],
        name="Texas",
        marker_color="red",
        opacity=0.8,
    )
)

# Display plot
fig.to_json()
</chart-code>
